due_when.clears_when: the Checkout step on a jta-infra job is under 30 s, or the hosted-vs-self-hosted total job time shows the clone does not matter (then kill)

observation.how_to_check: list_workflow_jobs on the newest vm-diag-snapshot run; started_at/completed_at of the 'Checkout repo' step
observation.what: Checkout step duration on a jta-infra runner job

origin.rerun: actions list_workflow_jobs on the newest vm-diag-snapshot run on a trainer-jta-infra-* runner; read the 'Checkout repo' step duration

what: jta-infra runner jobs re-clone the full repo every job (checkout step 2:49 on vm-diag-snapshot run 41636162263; one workspace measured 6.6 GB vs 17 GB free on the trainer), because the job hook deletes the workspace to protect the trainer disk. Cut it: sparse/filtered checkout (filter: blob:none or sparse-checkout of the paths each moved workflow reads) in the moved workflows, or a shared read-only reference clone the runners use via --reference.
